|-|Guides=
{{Achievement|Dead Change|jpg|Steal from the Dead}}
*In order to unlock this achievement, simply go loud at any point before opening the vault, play up to the CFO being dropped into the atrium, and pick up the money bundle next to his corpse.
{{Achievement|The Hunt for the Blue Sapphires|jpg|On the Diamond Heist find and pick up every sapphire outside the vault on the Overkill difficulty or above.}}
*The sapphire cases automatically shut and lock themselves after going loud, meaning this achievement must be attempted during a stealth run. It can be completed at any point in the mission so long as stealth is maintained.
